<!--
Thanks for contributing to MEMBRANE. A few real, evidence-based things
this project asks for in every PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md for the full
policy) — delete this comment block before submitting.
-->

## Summary

What changed and why, in your own words.

## Real testing evidence

What you actually ran, and what it showed (not what you expect it would
show). Reproducible commands preferred.

## Contributor rights

**If you are external to the project** (not the maintainer, and not
someone the maintainer has authorized to commit directly): this
repository requires a **validly signed**
[`CONTRIBUTOR_RIGHTS_AGREEMENT.md`](../CONTRIBUTOR_RIGHTS_AGREEMENT.md)
before your contribution can be merged. Opening this PR, CI passing, a
maintainer's review approval, or a plain comment do **not** count — a
signature is required via a qualified/secure electronic signature or a
wet-ink signed document (Agreement Section 27, Paths A/B). Comment on this
PR to start that process, or see `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "Contributor rights
and licensing" section for the full policy, including the narrow
maintainer-waiver exception.

## AI assistance disclosure

If AI tools materially assisted this contribution, say so here (see
README.md's own AI-assistance disclosure for this project's own
convention).
